lede: Join 5,000 Non-Resident Bengalis in establishing 5,000 integrated model farms across Bengal’s villages — launching from a live showcase at Durga Puja 2026.
notice: One village farm. One NRB patron. ₹1 lakh seed per farm.

stats.label: village integrated farms
stats.body: Local teams of 2–3 progressive farmers or FPOs put in land, labour and working capital.

stats.label: Non-Resident Bengali patrons
stats.body: Anyone with a native village in Bengal — whether they live abroad or in Kolkata.

stats.label: per farm
stats.body: In full, or ₹20,000 every two months over the year.

stats.label: 5,000 × ₹1 lakh
stats.body: The mobilisation to seed Bengal’s agricultural resurgence between Puja 2026 and Puja 2027.

how.body: Adopt a village farm, become a cluster or zonal Puja patron, or name your ancestral district so BKS can match you to soil you come from. Digital tracking follows every farm.
